rows.grounds: varjya plus āni; accusative plural neuter form used as noun
imperative second person singular active of root śru
indeclinable particle ca joined to sadāpi

items.question: Which practices must be avoided on those days even when enjoyment remains unobstructed?
premises: The verse commands the goddess to hear avoidable things.
It specifies those days as the occasion.
items.inference: Avoidable practices are to be heard and observed on those days always.
uncertainties: The exact list of avoidable practices is not given in this verse.
items.plain_english: Hear, O goddess, what must be avoided on those days, always too.
